subject.title: Bound diagnostic config file read with size cap

question: Should diagnostic support exports treat an existing config file larger than 8 MiB as unreadable in exchange for bounded memory use?
rationale: The patch is mechanically focused, but the threshold changes the result for a previously readable user-controlled config and the supplied discussion contains no maintainer approval of that compatibility boundary.

options.title: Accept the 8 MiB diagnostic limit
options.body: Merge the bounded read and document the accepted behavior that oversized config shapes are omitted from support bundles while the bundle itself still succeeds.

options.title: Choose a different compatibility boundary
options.body: Set a different limit or fallback behavior if maintainers need support exports to preserve larger existing config files.

recommendation.title: Accept the 8 MiB diagnostic limit
recommendation.body: Merge the bounded read and document the accepted behavior that oversized config shapes are omitted from support bundles while the bundle itself still succeeds.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the adjacent merged bounded-read pattern and can provide relevant implementation context, though the compatibility decision remains a maintainer choice.
